params.description: Filter by segment-aligned URL path prefix.

params.name: is_priority
params.description: Filter to (or exclude) priority pages.

params.name: has_optimized_content
params.description: Filter to (or exclude) pages with active AXP optimized content.

params.name: search
params.description: Case-insensitive substring match against the page URL or title.

params.description: Include per-page totals and percent-change columns for `agent_traffic`, `citations`, and `ai_referrals` over the selected date range.

params.name: start_date
params.description: Metrics start date (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to 30 days ago.

params.name: end_date
params.description: Metrics end date (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today.

items.docs:
Download every page matching the supplied filters as CSV or XLSX. Uses the same filters as the list endpoint but skips pagination.

With `include_metrics=true` (the default), each row also includes totals over the selected date range for `agent_traffic`, `citations`, and `ai_referrals`, plus a percent-change column comparing the first and last buckets of the range — matching the totals and trend percentages shown in the sitemap UI.

Limits:
- Maximum 10,000 rows per export.
- Maximum 366-day win

items.docs:
Return time-series performance metrics for a single page: citations, AI referrals, and AI agent traffic. Each metric is reported as a list of buckets keyed by date, with counts broken down by AI platform.

Granularity is chosen automatically based on the requested date range — short ranges return daily buckets, longer ranges return weekly buckets. Date ranges are capped at 366 days.

params.description: Filter by segment-aligned URL path prefix. For example `/blog` matches `/blog` and `/blog/post` but not `/blogger`.

params.description: Filter to (or exclude) pages flagged as priority for the brand.

params.name: has_optimized_content
params.description: Filter to (or exclude) pages with active AXP optimized content deployed.

params.name: search
params.description: Case-insensitive substring match against the page URL or title.

items.docs:
List pages discovered in the brand's sitemap with their title, description, depth, audit score, priority flag, and optimized-content flag.

Results come from the most recent completed crawl for the brand. Supports filtering by domain, URL depth, path prefix, priority flag, optimized-content flag, and a case-insensitive substring search across the page URL and title.

Results are paginated and ordered by depth then URL.
